headline: Ajax Engineering Limited: SEBI Regulation 31(4) Substantial Acquisition Disclosure
sum: Ajax Engineering Limited disclosed substantial acquisition of shares under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The company submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, indicating a material shareholding change or takeover-related transaction event.
detail: Ajax Engineering Limited filed a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the National Stock Exchange on or around 19 June 2026. This disclosure is a mandatory requirement when a person or group acquires shares/voting rights in a listed company beyond specified thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 35%, 50%, or 75%). The filing indicates a material corporate action affecting the company's shareholding structure.
